phases.title: Public use-case inventory and Rust foundation
deliverables: Publish generalized use cases, aliases and retirement decisions without private audit or parser metadata.
Ship offline catalog/roadmap text and JSON commands, Cargo lockfile and focused process tests.
platform_work: Record the Rust frontend versus platform-owned operational recipe boundary; no platform changes in this increment.
acceptance: All 41 historical spellings have a public summary, a disposition, a delivery phase and explicit planned/omitted status.
The Rust binary exposes only implemented commands; usage and not-found errors are structured in JSON mode.

phases.title: Active app owners and sensitive-read permission foundation
deliverables: Add local app owners list/check/add/remove through a versioned platform CLI contract.
Use active policy admins for audit.read, secrets.list, secrets.read and sqlite.download checks.
Apply owner-only changes with installation-operator authorization, expected stamps, last-owner protection and idempotent receipts.
platform_work: Use the platform owner guard and atomic native authority mutation through the existing Roc recipe host.
Secret values, SQLite export and production remote identity remain separate work.
acceptance: Unlisted operators and ordinary app users cannot change owners; installation operators do not implicitly pass owner checks.
Pending desired membership/resource edits never activate with an owner change; active and desired owner drift is visible.
Stale stamps, changed retry inputs, malformed identities and last-owner removal are refused; retry cannot resurrect a revoked owner.
Restored/disabled apps deny sensitive-read permissions; guards require the protected transaction.

phases.title: Context, identity and API access
deliverables: Implemented: exact app-origin/company/environment binding and OS credential storage, with no company defaults. Company-wide app context remains planned.

Implemented with local/mock evidence: Google IAP desktop browser login/whoami/logout, PKCE, signed ID tokens, refresh and app-session verification. Hosted instance qualification, local-session call/openapi and explicit token export remain required.
Preserve raw HTTP output, bounded requests, body sources and exact idempotency keys; add generated shell completion and selected-context app cache.
platform_work: Review and establish a versioned standalone CLI integration contract; existing day2-host/workflow protocols are private.

Publish exact-origin public discovery and allowlist a company desktop OAuth client; qualify live IAP/session bootstrap and native OS credential stores. Managed credential readiness is a separate installation gate.
acceptance: A local Reports query and idempotent command succeed via the real generated API; a 202 receipt can be polled.
Wrong instance/origin/audience, expired session, missing CSRF and redirect credential leaks have negative checks.
Headless mode fails without prompting; no v1 token import, ambient credential fallback or uncertain write retry.
Completion advertises only implemented commands and performs no implicit network/login work.

phases.title: Roc app creation and managed local development
deliverables: Add app new from the canonical Roc app layout with exact provenance, atomic destination placement and no remote.
Expose app describe, build/check/test and local-dev through the reviewed platform surface.
Provide persistent state, watch/rebuild, detach/status/stop/logs/follow, explicit reset and development-only bindings.
platform_work: Provide a relocatable/versioned recipe entry point or coordinate an in-place platform CLI frontend replacement.
Keep build/admission/check/local-dev composition in existing ops recipes, including required evidence and UI dependency verification.
acceptance: A new app builds, passes its app-owned checks and serves locally without a production login.
Data survives normal restarts; reset is explicit; stop cannot terminate unrelated processes.
Dry-run performs no network/Git/write effects and rejects collisions, symlink escapes and invalid layouts.
CLI output identifies platform version, admitted artifact and protected verification evidence.

phases.title: Snapshots and app operations visibility
deliverables: Add local snapshot list/export/tables/schema/query against verified read-only bundles, then authorized remote capture/index/download.
Add bounded app-scoped logs, traces, monitors and trusted dashboard links through an instance service.
Add explicit snapshot import into local development, separate from default app startup.
platform_work: Expose authenticated snapshot and observability contracts and qualify instance provider bindings.
Preserve online backup, artifact identity, restore epoch rotation and explicit grant reactivation.
acceptance: Snapshot tampering, wrong app/database, archive traversal, invalid SQL and over-budget queries are refused.
SELECT inspection cannot mutate a live database; fresh capture is treated as an explicit effect.
No tenant credentials or unrestricted provider query language reach CLI output; owner/app authorization has negative checks.
Restore retains data but does not reactivate copied grants; GoLinks persisted links remain intact.

phases.title: Directory, app provisioning and publication
deliverables: Implement bounded canonical directory resolution and server-side access revalidation.
Add durable app provision and app publish with exact source snapshot/commit, review-only and resumable request receipts.
Use instance-selected source hosting, review, isolated build and release capabilities.
platform_work: Provide an authenticated create/status/approval service and qualify source, infrastructure and release adapters.
Use the existing durable journal and approved recipes; never create an app-authored CI or second configuration catalog.
acceptance: Ambiguous/truncated/suspended directory matches cannot grant access.
Interrupted requests resume with the same identity and source digest; duplicate delivery creates no duplicate resource.
A changed source snapshot requires fresh approval; secrets and local state never enter source exports.
Unknown mutation outcomes reconcile by exact journal/provider evidence; review-only cannot merge or deploy.

phases.title: Secret lifecycle and guarded recovery
deliverables: Add metadata-only list/prepare/latest/status/wait and owned agent-guidance installation.
Add human-only hidden add/update entry through the approved material channel and versioned request receipts.
Expose reconcile/retry/exact/transition/terminated recovery only where Day 2 has a reviewed equivalent.
platform_work: Build authenticated operator/material-entry service contracts over runtime-secret resource/version and consumer-protection models.
Qualify provider projection/readback and exact workflow-history recovery; do not emulate v1 endpoint semantics in the client.
acceptance: No credential values enter argv, environment, agent JSON, receipts, logs, journal or generated source.
Hidden input cannot fall back to visible input; cancellation/EOF does not submit; multiline content is preserved.
Wrong request/run/task/checkpoint, stale authority, redirects and ambiguous recovery responses are refused without automatic mutation retry.
Accepted/queued/active/failed/unknown states remain distinct; an accepted mutation is not proof of runtime use.

phases.title: Distribution and optional instance database tooling
deliverables: Publish reproducible, checksummed CLI releases and package-manager installations for a tested target matrix.
Implement update using installation ownership, atomic standalone replacement and exact release integrity.
Qualify optional instance-owned PostgreSQL/IAP db connect independently from the SQLite app runtime.
platform_work: Resolve platform bundle portability and version negotiation before claiming a standalone operational distribution.
Keep bastions, source hosts, cloud projects and provider credentials in private instance configuration.
acceptance: Clean-machine install and supported-platform smoke checks pass without a platform source checkout.
Tampered assets, interrupted update and package-manager ownership are handled safely; incompatible platform versions fail clearly.
Tunnel phase timeouts, occupied ports, PostgreSQL readiness and Ctrl-C cleanup are checked with bounded fixtures.
No v1 compatibility command or retired metrics operation is shipped.
